notes.title: Update v1.0
notes.notes:
Fixed various box carrying issues by limiting the carry angle
Fixed music sometimes not resuming after being alt+tabbed for some time
Fixed light bridge not fully activating when VCR is paused in the same frame it's switched on
Fixed a light bridge sometimes not being visible on level 15: Radial
Fixed minor texture issues on level 6: Treble

notes.title: Update v0.99
notes.notes:
Added 2 achievements
Changed key bindings to show icons instead of text
Game now pauses when Steam overlay is activated
Fixed gamepad controls still working when Steam overlay is visible
Fixed bug where music volume would reset to max when system audio device changes
Fixed up/down navigation in Settings > Controls

notes.title: Update v0.98
notes.notes:
Added gamepad rebinding support
Added gamepad rumble, with setting to disable
Improved layout of level 2: Tetra
Improved settings navigation (mouse right-click and left & right keys to cycle through settings)
Impact punch angle now records & rewinds
Fixed issue where reflections would disappear (Unity URP bug)
Fixed bug where smooth carrying of a box wasn't being applied
Fixed seeing speed change on VCR HUD when 'vcr state' HUD setting is off
Various other fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Update v0.97
notes.notes:
Added new level: Interlinked (Replaced level: Nexus)
Added new level: Radial (Replaced level: Bilateral)
Added level time difference to level summary screen, shown when replaying levels
Added animated collectible display to HUD and summary screen, shown when the secret is found
Improved end area in level: Oscillator
Improved VCR HUD rewind speed display (now animates and briefly shows other speeds)
Fixed some sounds not adhering to SFX volume setting
Fixed incorrect VCR HUD layout when resolution is changed while game is running

notes.title: Update v0.96.1
notes.notes:
Fixed potential soft-lock and other improvements to level 5 (Wham)
Improved ice so it looks more icy
Improved material on crusher cubes
Improved audible feedback when Boosters are switched on & off
Other minor demo-only related improvements

notes.title: Update v0.96
notes.notes:
Reworked underground area of level 5 (Wham)
Layout improvements, and increased par time on level 3 (Bumble)
Layout improvements to level 11 (Tempo)
Made boxes easier to pickup (can be picked up from futher away, and without needing to aim so precisely)
Improvements to beginning cutscene (better caption layout & timings and updated VCR model)
Added hidden achievement
Added endgame variation when game is 100% complete
Subtle lighting & spatial audio improvements throughout all levels
Fixed rare soft-lock bug where player can be dead inside a stasis chamber
Bug that stopped some players walking left (lol) has been fixed - was a Unity bug! (UUM-71799)
Various other tweaks and improvements throughout

notes.title: Update v0.95
notes.notes:
Replaced level 6: Bounce with new level: Treble
Reworked level 18: Hammered
Reworked level 19: Oscillator
Small rework to level 7: Travelators
Small rework to level 14: Rebound (Hidden collectible now in new location)
Improved visuals on level 10: Smash
Improved entrance room visuals on various levels
Added new & improved floor switch sounds
Fixed idle animations being queued when 'dead' and playing when 'alive' again
Fixed player velocity reduction that occurs when repeatedly pausing when flying through the air
Fixed main menu music stopping abruptly when continuing a level - now fades out gracefully
Other fixes & improvements throughout

notes.title: Update v0.94
notes.notes:
Added hints to Level 4 (Chronograph)
Reworked above-ground area of Level 5 (Wham)
Reworked Level 10 (Smash)
Improvements to Level 1 (Beta TV) and improved tutorial info screens
Improvements to Level 7 (Travelators)
Improvements to Level 8 (Disco)
Improvements to Level 12 (Superflux)
Changed Settings Controls to display "pause / rewind slower" & "shoot / rewind faster"
Fixed player not being crushed when stopping rewinding whilst overlapping a KinematicMover
Fixed sometimes being stuck in crouch when exiting a stasis chamber
Fixed player being able to push boxes through doors, walls, etc

notes.title: Update v0.93.3
notes.notes:
Modified access to secret areas on some levels so they're easier to get to
Fixed player sometimes not being able to pickup a box
Fixed some missing colliders on level 7
Fixed end game cutscene not playing if exited to menu after final level, then continued

notes.title: Update v0.93.2
notes.notes:
Added box auto-release when carried into range of a floor switch
Added extension and improvements to level 4
Small improvement to underground area of level 5
Small improvement to end-game cutscene
Fixed audio glitches sometimes heard when alt+tabbed
Fixed misaligned level challenge state icons on pause menu

notes.title: Update v0.93.1
notes.notes:
Added idle animations
Added auto-pause after 30s of inactivity
Improved Light Bridge
Other small fixes & improvements

notes.title: Update v0.93
notes.notes:
Added cutscene at the end of the game
Added new layout and other big changes & improvements to Bumble (Level 3)
Added running & remote control spin animations
Added pause key information to tutorial level
Added music being affected when rewinding, with setting to disable it
Added changing of crosshair color when targeting switches & picking up boxes
Added new box collision sounds
Fixed jump cancelling boost, when jumping soon after being boosted
Fixed SFX playing when app is in background (when ALT & tabbed)
Fixed clouds not being visible
Various other fixes, improvements & optimizations

notes.title: Update v0.92
notes.notes:
Optimized lighting data (game data size is now substantially smaller)
 Various additions to levels
 Several changes, fixes & improvements

notes.title: Update v0.91
notes.notes:
Lots of optimizations
Some secret area enhancements
Fixed music not playing in Credits scene
Fixed Booster activated & boost sound interruption

notes.title: Update v0.9
notes.notes:
Improved player movement, walking up steps no longer reduces horizontal movement
Substantial enhancements to secret areas
Changed Booster sounds
Added particle effects & screen shake when a Mux is activated
Fixed not being able to interact with wall switches when up-close
Level selection screen times now all show hours if one level is over 1 hour
Many other fixes, improvements & optimizations throughout

notes.title: Update v0.84
notes.notes:
Changed level start animation, now consistent with restarting
Added setting for allowing music to continue playing when app has lost focus (ALT+Tabbed)
Fixed level summary screen *sometimes* showing level time as 00:00.00
Tweaked layout & lighting near end of Level 7: Travelators
Finished layout of final level (Terminus)
As usual, other small tweaks & fixes

notes.title: Update v0.83
notes.notes:
Improved design of settings & level selection UI
Added settings for configuring HUD elements
Added settings for changing the crosshair, 10 to choose from
HUD can now optionally include the level time & level par time
Improved level entrance appearance
Improved restart effect when restarting by entering the level entrance
Various other small tweaks & fixes

notes.title: Update v0.82
notes.notes: Fixed bug where mouse look wouldn't work for some players

notes.title: Update v0.81
notes.notes:
Rewinding to 00:00 now auto-pauses
Improved how video settings are displayed and applied
Added 'target frame rate' option to video settings
Fixed bug on first level where lasers weren't resetting after restarting level
Additional minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update v0.8
notes.notes:
Implemented jump buffering
Tweaked/improved player movement
Various small changes & fixes

notes.title: Update v0.78
notes.notes:
Added hands animations & improved look
 Clearer box info on level intro screens
 Various fixes
